contracts.commit_point: The guardrail verdict at guard evaluation time: the returned GuardrailFunctionOutput with tripwire_triggered=not can_negotiate (orchestrator.py lines 159-162), which blocks the rate_negotiator run at agent-invocation time before agent execution. The effect that commits on pass is the agent-run invocation itself (invocation-only); no downstream external commit for rate_negotiator is wired in the supplied source.
contracts.declared_mechanism: Input guardrail: the @input_guardrail-decorated async function negotiator_guardrail(ctx, agent, input) computes can_negotiate from the three preconditions and returns GuardrailFunctionOutput(output_info=can_negotiate, tripwire_triggered=not can_negotiate); it is attached to the agent via input_guardrails=[negotiator_guardrail], so it evaluates at rate_negotiator invocation time, before the agent executes.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Invoking/running the rate_negotiator agent when can_negotiate is false, i.e., when any of the following holds: rate_info is missing or rate_info.rate_usd is None (no offered rate); rate_info.minimum_rate is None or rate_info.maximum_rate is None (bounds undefined); or load_context.warnings is non-empty (outstanding warnings). The guard formalizes this as GuardrailFunctionOutput(tripwire_triggered=not can_negotiate).
pending_binding_information: Whether rate_negotiator output flows onward to broker communication (send_email/send_reply via the Communicator Agent), which would constitute a distinct communication-stratum commit point; no such wiring appears in the supplied source and dynamic_negotiation_agent_instructions is not supplied.
Whether load_context.rate_info or load_context.warnings can change during the manager run (e.g., via the update_warnings or update_details tools) after the guard's single evaluation point.
Concrete definitions of OrchestratorContext, the load context object, rate_info fields (rate_usd, minimum_rate, maximum_rate), and warnings (models module not supplied).
Content of dynamic_negotiation_agent_instructions: what the guarded agent actually does when the guard passes.
Whether any code path other than the Manager Agent's negotiate_rate dispatch can invoke rate_negotiator.
contracts.protected_operation: Rate negotiation performed by the rate_negotiator agent run, reached via the negotiate_rate tool dispatched by the Manager Agent (analyzer) during the process_broker_email workflow run.
contracts.protected_resource: The rate_negotiator Agent[OrchestratorContext] ('Rate Negotiator Agent') run and the OrchestratorContext.load_context rate/warnings state it is gated on (rate_info.rate_usd, rate_info.minimum_rate, rate_info.maximum_rate, load_context.warnings).
contracts.protection_obligation: The Rate Negotiator Agent (rate_negotiator) must not execute its rate-negotiation run unless the load context simultaneously has (a) a broker-offered rate (rate_info.rate_usd is not None), (b) defined minimum and maximum rate bounds (rate_info.minimum_rate and rate_info.maximum_rate are not None), and (c) no outstanding warnings (load_context.warnings is empty or absent). When any precondition fails, the registered input guardrail must trip (tripwire_triggered) and block the run before the agent executes. (Merged contract: the two reviewer opinions state the same obligation in conjunctive and disjunctive form and are combined here.)
scope_limits: The guard is declared only on rate_negotiator; no other agent or tool in the supplied file (extract_details, analyze_warnings, answer_question, cancel_load on the Manager Agent; send_email, cancel_load on the Communicator Agent) carries this guard.

The guard reads load_context.rate_info and load_context.warnings from the OrchestratorContext constructed at run start (process_broker_email, lines 339-353); the supplied source does not show re-evaluation if update_warnings (upsert_load_warnings) or update_details (update_load_reply_status) mutate that state mid-run.

Only the agent-invocation commit is demonstrated in source; the reviewer-referenced downstream broker-communication effect for negotiated rates is not wired in the supplied file (rate_negotiator declares no tools; no dataflow to send_reply/communicator is shown), so no separate communication-stratum contract is emitted.
